can_approve_pull_request_reviews.public_reason: publication-pr.yml creates the snapshot PRs with github.token (publication_pr.py create_pr → POST pulls). Safe: required_approving_review_count is 0 with require_code_owner_reviews and github-actions owns no path, so the owner's review is still required outside the generated files.

private_main_protection.reason: Private workflows write runtime state to main through the contents API (for example runtime/gemini-hourly.json via apps/pipeline/src/mdh_pipeline/review_queue.py), so classic branch protection would block the bots.
